newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil premiums hold up against softer futures.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil premiums hold up against softer futures.

text.p: NWE gas oil was broadly steady on Thursday with premiums for most grades looking firm against very narrowly easier futures.
May IPE gas oil last traded 50 cents down at $162.25 a tonne having been rescued from intra-day lows of $161.75 by stronger NYMEX heating oil.
Russian gas oil was showing renewed strength gaining upwards of $2 on the back of tight supplies for Europe.
"Offers are at May IPE +$3.50 cif Rotterdam with bids at +$2," said one trader who added that large-size cargoes were almost exclusively heading to Asia.

Diesel premiums were also holding after a slight dip earlier in the week with prompt material hard to find and offers heard as high as May IPE +$14 cif NWE. Further out material, however was pegged around May IPE +$11-12.
FOD premiums were holding steady at May IPE +$5 cif, but DIN was marginally easier around +$4.50 cif.
